params.samples: all 1,980 METABRIC tumours with expression (Illumina HT-12, log2 intensity as distributed by cBioPortal)
params.genes: the TCGA main clustering genes (top 2,000 non-PAM50, sex genes removed) that are present in METABRIC
params.scaling: z-score per gene within METABRIC (each cohort standardised separately). This removes platform offsets but assumes the two cohorts have a broadly similar subtype mix, because a cohort with more ER-negative tumours would have its gene means shifted; the ER-IHC negative share is logged per cohort to check this (ER_negative_share_by_cohort)
params.quantile_mapping_sensitivity: each METABRIC gene mapped onto the TCGA distribution of the same gene (rank -> TCGA quantile), then z-scored with the TCGA mean and SD and assigned by the same nearest-centroid rule; reported per k as cluster shares, ER-negative shares and ARI vs the main assignment. Not used for the main result
params.pc1_orientation: PC1 sign chosen so that PC1 correlates positively with ESR1 expression
params.batch_check: eta-squared of PC1-10 on METABRIC COHORT (1-5, known processing batches), ER_IHC, HER2 gain, CLAUDIN_SUBTYPE (NC dropped)
params.centroid_projection: each METABRIC tumour assigned to the nearest TCGA k-means centroid by Euclidean distance in z-units over the shared genes (the k-means rule itself); checked by re-applying the rule to TCGA, where it must reproduce the k-means labels
params.centroid_projection_sensitivity: Pearson-correlation nearest centroid, reported but not used
params.ER_negative_share: share of ER-IHC negative among tumours with a known ER-IHC result
